locations.name: ✈️ LAX – Los Angeles International Airport
locations.description: YYZ departs 08:30 → LAX arrives 10:55 AM. Backpack travel — no baggage claim wait; straight through arrivals to lower level for rental car shuttle.

locations.name: 🚗 Fox Rent a Car – LAX (Europcar/Booking.com) ✅
locations.description: BOOKED ✅ via Booking.com (served by Fox Rent a Car). Address: 5251 W 98th St Suite 562, Los Angeles 90045. Phone: +1 (323) 673-9084. Process: follow pink LAX Shuttle signs on arrivals level → free shuttle to this location → go to the Fox Rent a Car desk. Bring: Canadian driver's licence + credit card + booking confirmation. Say NO to: FasTrak add-on (zero tolls on your routes) and Europcar's own insurance (RBC Avion Visa Infinite covers CDW). Opening hours: 12:00 AM–12:30 AM and 5:00 AM–11:59 PM.
locations.price: Booked — Toyota Yaris or similar Economy

locations.name: 🏨 Hollywood City Inn
locations.description: 1615 North Western Avenue, Hollywood, CA 90027. Check-in from 3:00 PM — drop backpacks at front desk and head out on foot. Free parking. Car stays parked all afternoon — no driving needed today.

locations.name: 🚢 Crossroads of the World
locations.description: 6671 Sunset Blvd, Hollywood — quirky 1936 Art Deco landmark shaped like a ship's prow with a spinning globe on top, surrounded by small cottage-style buildings. LA's first pedestrian shopping mall; now offices. 5-min walk from hotel, 5-min photo stop.

locations.name: 🎬 Egyptian Theatre
locations.description: 6712 Hollywood Blvd — Hollywood's first movie palace (1922), designed in Egyptian Revival style with hieroglyphic-decorated forecourt and colonnade. Now operated by Netflix as a premiere venue. Quick exterior photo stop.

locations.name: 🍽️ Musso & Frank Grill
locations.description: 6667 Hollywood Blvd — Hollywood's oldest restaurant, open since 1919. The red-and-black awning and vintage neon sign make for a great photo. Regulars over the years included Charlie Chaplin, Raymond Chandler, and Hunter S. Thompson.

locations.name: 🎭 El Capitan Theatre
locations.description: 6838 Hollywood Blvd — Disney's ornate 1941 historic premiere theatre with a colourful Spanish Colonial Revival facade. Typically has themed window displays tied to current Disney releases. Right across from TCL Chinese Theatre.

locations.name: 🏛️ Hollywood & Highland – Babylon Court
locations.description: 6801 Hollywood Blvd at Highland Ave — the giant open-air Babylon Court arch perfectly frames the Hollywood Sign in the hills. Best photo: stand at the base of the steps looking up through the arch toward the hills. Also home to the Dolby Theatre (Oscars venue). Free to enter and explore.

locations.name: 🏨 Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel
locations.description: 7000 Hollywood Blvd — built in 1927, hosted the very first Academy Awards ceremony in 1929. Stunning Spanish Colonial exterior with the neon Roosevelt sign. Located right next to TCL Chinese Theatre. Quick exterior photo.

locations.name: 🗿 Madame Tussauds Hollywood
locations.description: 6933 Hollywood Blvd — life-size celebrity figure displays are visible from the street. Free photo ops at street level without buying a ticket.

locations.name: 🎬 TCL Chinese Theatre
locations.description: Iconic Hollywood landmark — see celebrity handprints and footprints cast in concrete in the forecourt. Free to browse outside; open from 8 AM. More info

locations.name: ⭐ Hollywood Walk of Fame
locations.description: Stroll Hollywood Blvd and spot celebrity stars embedded in the sidewalk. This stretch connects TCL Chinese Theatre westward toward Vine St — golden afternoon light makes for great photos.

locations.name: 💿 Capitol Records Building
locations.description: 1750 N Vine St, Hollywood — the iconic circular tower designed to look like a stack of records with a stylus on top. Opened 1956; Frank Sinatra, Nat King Cole, and The Beatles all recorded here. Short walk east from TCL Chinese Theatre, then south on Vine.

locations.name: 🎭 Hollywood Pantages Theatre
locations.description: 6233 Hollywood Blvd, near Hollywood & Vine — quick photo stop. Stunning Art Deco exterior built in 1930; one of LA's most beautiful historic theatres. Free to admire and photograph outside. More info

locations.name: 🌟 Hollywood Blvd – Night Atmosphere
locations.description: Hollywood Blvd transforms after dark — neon signs, lit-up TCL Chinese Theatre forecourt, and street performers. A casual evening stroll before dinner to soak up the night atmosphere.

locations.name: 🍔 In-N-Out Burger – Sunset Blvd
locations.description: 7009 Sunset Blvd, Hollywood — ~5 min drive from hotel. Drive-thru + dine-in. Open Sun–Thu 10:30 AM – 1:00 AM · Fri–Sat 10:30 AM – 1:30 AM. Classic Double-Double, Animal Style fries. Location page

days.title: ZIPANGU Festival at the Rose Bowl

locations.name: 🌅 Hotel – Leisurely Morning
locations.description: Leisurely breakfast near the hotel; rest up and charge up for the big night ahead

locations.name: 🅿️ Rose Bowl Official Parking – ZIPANGU
locations.description: Official ZIPANGU event parking at Rose Bowl lots. Route: CA-134 E → exit Orange Grove Blvd → left on Rosemont Ave → right on Seco St → follow event signage into lots. Parking types: General · Preferred (Lot B & H) · Super VIP (Lot D) · Rideshare drop-off (Lot H). Credit card only — no cash. No shuttle service. Venue is a short walk (~5–10 min) from the lots. Pre-purchase parking at checkout or via the official site. Getting Here

locations.name: 🎵 ZIPANGU Festival – Brookside at the Rose Bowl
locations.description: First major Japanese music festival on US soil! Lineup: Ado ★ Headliner (~1 hr closing set inside the iconic Ado Box) · ATARASHII GAKKO! · MAN WITH A MISSION · CHANMINA · HANA · 10-FEET · Yuki Chiba. Doors: 3:30 PM · First acts: ~4:00 PM · Ado closes: ~10:00 PM. Capacity ~35,000. Organizer: Cloud Nine × Goldenvoice (Coachella organizers). Park in official Rose Bowl lots (see parking entry above) — ~5–10 min walk to festival entrance. Official Site

locations.name: 🚗 Drive Back to Hotel
locations.description: After Ado's closing set (~10:00 PM), follow posted crowd flow paths back to your Rose Bowl parking lot (~5–10 min walk). Allow 20–30 min to exit with post-show traffic. Drive back to Hollywood City Inn (~30 min via I-210 W → US-101 S). Home by ~11:00–11:30 PM.

days.title: Hills · Griffith · Beverly Hills · Santa Monica → Depart

locations.name: 🌅 Hotel – Final Morning
locations.description: Last breakfast in Hollywood. Check out by 11:00 AM — load backpacks into car and head out for a driving day. No return to hotel needed.

locations.name: 🎬 Lake Hollywood Park – Hollywood Sign View
locations.description: Weidlake Dr, Hollywood Hills — the best close-up Hollywood Sign viewpoint without any hiking. Park on Weidlake Dr (free street parking); the sign looms directly above the reservoir. ~15 min drive from hotel. Go right after checkout to beat the midday crowds.

locations.name: 🔭 Griffith Observatory
locations.description: ~15 min drive from Lake Hollywood. Free admission; sweeping panoramic LA views with the Hollywood Sign in the backdrop. Opens 12:00 PM on Sundays — arrive right at opening to beat crowds. Official Site

locations.name: 🍔 Lunch
locations.description: Last meal in LA — many options in Hollywood or along Sunset Blvd heading west.

locations.name: 🏰 Chateau Marmont
locations.description: 8221 Sunset Blvd, West Hollywood — legendary Gothic Revival hotel built in 1929; one of Hollywood's most storied celebrity retreats. Photograph the dramatic ivy-draped facade from Sunset Blvd. Quick drive-by or park and snap. Conveniently on the westward route toward LAX.

locations.name: 🎸 Whisky a Go Go
locations.description: 8901 Sunset Blvd, West Hollywood — legendary rock club opened 1964; The Doors, Led Zeppelin, Alice Cooper and countless others played here. Quick photo of the iconic marquee sign on the Sunset Strip. Continuing west on Sunset puts you naturally toward Beverly Hills and LAX.

locations.name: 🌸 The Beverly Hills Hotel
locations.description: 9641 Sunset Blvd, Beverly Hills — the iconic 'Pink Palace' opened 1912; Marilyn Monroe, Frank Sinatra, and Elizabeth Taylor were regulars. The vivid pink-and-green banana-leaf facade is one of LA's most recognisable landmarks. Quick exterior photo from Sunset Blvd — continuing west puts you right into Beverly Hills.

locations.name: 🛍️ Rodeo Drive
locations.description: Rodeo Drive at Brighton Way, Beverly Hills — the world's most famous luxury shopping street; Chanel, Gucci, Hermès, Louis Vuitton line a beautifully landscaped pedestrian strip. Two Rodeo (at the south end) is a cobblestone European-style lane worth walking. Free to stroll and photograph — no purchase necessary.

locations.name: 🌿 Beverly Gardens Park – Beverly Hills Sign
locations.description: Santa Monica Blvd & N Crescent Dr, Beverly Hills — the famous electric 'Beverly Hills' script sign with a lily pond and fountain behind it; one of the most-photographed spots in the city. Beverly Gardens Park runs 1.9 miles along Santa Monica Blvd — the sign is at the eastern end. 5-min walk from Rodeo Drive.

locations.name: 🏛️ Beverly Hills City Hall
locations.description: 455 N Rexford Dr, Beverly Hills — stunning 1932 Spanish Colonial Revival building with a distinctive green copper dome; appeared in numerous films and TV shows. Free to photograph from the street. 5-min walk from Beverly Gardens Park.

locations.name: 🎡 Santa Monica Pier
locations.description: 200 Santa Monica Pier, Santa Monica — the iconic pier at the end of historic Route 66; look for the 'End of the Trail' Route 66 sign on the pier. Pacific Park amusement rides and the Ferris wheel are photogenic even without riding. Walk to the end for sweeping Pacific Ocean views — a perfect send-off before flying home. ~25 min drive from Beverly Hills; only ~15–20 min from LAX. Official Site

locations.name: ✈️ LAX – Departure to Toronto (YYZ)
locations.time: Leave 7:15 PM · Return car 8:00 PM · 22:35 flight
locations.description: Leave last stop by 7:15 PM → drive ~35–40 min → arrive LAX Rental Car Center by 8:00 PM → return car (~10 min) → free shuttle to terminal (~8:30 PM) → mobile check-in + TSA security → at gate by ~9:15 PM. Gate closes ~10:05 PM. Flight departs 22:35 → YYZ arrives Mon 06:24 (Victoria Day 🇨🇦).
